description: backend.rs SetError struct (line 55) has no max_size: Option<u64> field and no with_max_size() builder. RFC 8621 §7.5 says: "A maxSize UnsignedInt property MUST be present on the SetError specifying the maximum size of a message that may be sent, in octets" whenever a backend returns TooLarge for an EmailSubmission. Because SetError is #[non_exhaustive] and serialized by serde, a backend cannot currently express this mandatory field — the only escape valve is description (a String), which is wrong type and wrong JSON key. Fix: add pub max_size: Option<u64> and with_max_size(n: u64) to SetError and its serde rename.
